answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 40 slots; top 40 bids enter. An agent bids 50 POA, locks it 20 epochs, and a random audit slashes it if the work is fake. The honest reef grows job by job, an orchard tended slowly, each good job set in onyx in the ledger. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA against a pool of about 3,000 POA: a sure loss. An honest agent pays 50 POA once, gets it back, and keeps a full undiluted share.
